title: Should Schools Require Uniforms?
text:
Many schools require students to wear uniforms. Supporters argue that uniforms reduce the pressure to compete over expensive clothes. In my opinion, this argument is convincing, because it makes students feel more equal. However, critics claim that uniforms limit self-expression.

Admittedly, uniforms do not solve every social problem. Some students, for instance, may still judge each other by their shoes or bags. Nevertheless, I believe that the benefits outweigh the drawbacks. A well-designed uniform policy is therefore a sensible choice for most schools.

questions.text: What do supporters argue about uniforms?
options: They are always cheaper to make
They reduce the pressure to compete over expensive clothes
They are required by law everywhere

questions.text: What do some students still do, according to the second paragraph?
options: Judge each other by their shoes or bags

questions.text: What is the author's overall attitude toward school uniforms?
Why does the author begin the second paragraph with the word 'admittedly'?
options: To agree completely with the critics
To concede a limitation before stating their own view
To introduce a new topic about fashion
To show uncertainty about the facts

vocabulary.definition: making you believe that something is true or right
people who publicly disagree with or disapprove of something
advantages or good effects that something provides

paragraph_translations: Muitas escolas exigem que os alunos usem uniforme. Os defensores argumentam que os uniformes reduzem a pressão para competir por roupas caras. Na minha opinião, esse argumento é convincente, porque faz os alunos se sentirem mais iguais. No entanto, os críticos afirmam que os uniformes limitam a autoexpressão.

É verdade que os uniformes não resolvem todos os problemas sociais. Alguns alunos, por exemplo, ainda podem julgar os colegas pelos sapatos ou pelas mochilas. Mesmo assim, acredito que os benefícios superam as desvantagens. Uma política de uniformes bem planejada é, portanto, uma escolha sensata para a maioria das escolas.
